papers_found.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
papers_found.relevance_notes: Fine-grained task decomposition significantly improves risk-adjusted returns vs coarse-grained. Alignment between agent output and downstream decision is key driver. Directly suggests ML overlay experiment on our confirmed strategies.

papers_found.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
papers_found.relevance_notes: Bull/Bear researcher agents + risk management team. ≥23.21% cumulative return, +6.1% vs best baseline. Architecture inspiration for multi-agent enhancement of our pipeline.

papers_found.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
papers_found.relevance_notes: FinBERT best for PEAD direction (57.6% accuracy). Adding 3-day early market signal improves prediction. Directly validates H163/H174 FinBERT choice and suggests confirming filter improvement.

papers_found.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_found.relevance_notes: FinBERT effective for soft information from press releases. LDA adds interpretability. Confirms FinBERT direction, lower priority than main PEAD paper.

papers_found.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
papers_found.relevance_notes: Bias elimination mask adds 0.44 Sharpe-point — first-order driver exceeding model architecture. XGBoost/LightGBM dominate. 9 Alpha101 factors including momentum. Directly actionable on H198 follow-up.
